overview.lead: Shamans support a group with totems, heals and utility, and play as casters (Elemental), melee (Enhancement) or healers (Restoration). Blizzard rates them among the sturdiest classes thanks to mail and a shield, but says their crowd control is weak.

points.text: For Olympus, Dwarf is the only Alliance Shaman race. Shamans were Horde-only in Classic, so this is the first time Alliance raids get Windfury, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air and Mana Tide.
No raid-wide Bloodlust or Heroism has been announced; Blizzard made Rage of the Farseer a personal cooldown on purpose.

101.summary: What every Shaman should know before choosing a spec.

overview.lead: Elemental casts Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and shocks. Call of Thunder improves the crit chance of both lightning spells by 5%.

points.text: Lightning Mastery is the new name for the 31-point Elemental Mastery talent. Lava Burst is no longer part of the rotation.
Lightning Overload now has a 10%, 20% or 30% chance to copy a Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Earthbound (16 points) makes Earthbind Totem root nearby enemies for 5 s when placed, which helps you kite.
Call of Thunder gives both lightning spells 5% additional crit. The older Lava Burst allocation is a beta artifact.
Eye of the Storm can reduce pushback on your lightning casts when enemies reach you.
Weapon imbues now last 60 minutes, so one cast covers a long questing session.
Use Flame Shock when the target will live long enough for its damage over time. Build your direct damage around Lightning Bolt.
Fill with Lightning Bolt (2.5 s cast at rank 4 and up); Elemental Alacrity shortens it.
Use Chain Lightning on groups when its higher mana cost is worthwhile.
Place your saved totems with Call of the Elements. Totemic Call moves them to you without recasting them.
Elemental Focus gives a 10% chance after a Fire, Frost or Nature damage spell to make your next damage spell free.
Persistent buff totems last 5 minutes and the totem global cooldown is 1.0 s, so totem upkeep takes less of your time.
Chain Lightning casts in 2.5 seconds and costs about 2.25 times as much mana as Lightning Bolt of a comparable rank.
Use Flame Shock where its damage over time can finish, and save fire totems for fights where their targets stay in range.
Ghost Wolf runs at 40% speed per Warcraft Tavern; Improved Ghost Wolf in Enhancement makes it usable indoors.

omitted.reason: The spec overview above covers this.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: Elemental burst relies on lightning and shocks. Call of Thunder adds crit to Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.
You have no hard crowd control (no stun, no Hex), but Earthbound roots, Tremor Totem counters fear, charm and sleep, and Purge strips enemy buffs (Warcraft Tavern).
Mail, a shield and Ghost Wolf help you survive, and Guardian Totems (Enhancement) shortens Grounding Totem's cooldown.
Against Warlock: Drop Tremor Totem before their Fear lands; Warcraft Tavern notes Warlocks have no blink or sprint, so Earthbind and range let you control the fight.
Against Rogue: Earthbound roots nearby enemies for 5 s when you place Earthbind Totem, which buys distance for your casts.

overview.lead: Enhancement is the Shaman melee spec: weapon swings with Stormstrike, Shocks and Lightning Bolts sped up by Maelstrom Weapon.

points.text: Stormstrike is a 16-point talent on a six-second cooldown. Spirit Weapons arrives at 21 points and Rage of the Farseer at 31.
Blizzard only calls Enhancement a temporary tank for small groups; no raid-tank role has been announced.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Two-handed axes and maces are baseline, so you can level with a two-hander.
Improved Ghost Wolf: rank 1 cuts Ghost Wolf's cast by 1 s and lets you use it indoors, and rank 2 makes it instant.
Thundering Strikes adds crit, which triggers Flurry's faster swings; Mental Dexterity turns Intellect into Attack Power.
Stormstrike comes at 16 points and Spirit Weapons at 21.
Keep a weapon imbue up (60 minutes now); Elemental Weapons strengthens Windfury Weapon (13% at rank 1).
Use Stormstrike on cooldown, then spend its 20% bonus on Earth Shock or Lightning Bolt within 12 s.
When Maelstrom Weapon has stacked up, cast Lightning Bolt; each stack cuts its cast time and mana (4% per stack at rank 1, up to 5 stacks).
Use Rage of the Farseer for burst; it only affects you.
Keep Lightning Shield up; Shamanistic Focus cuts its cost by 45%.
Spirit Weapons cuts your threat by 30% unless Rockbiter Weapon is active and raises it by 30% with Rockbiter, so use Rockbiter only when you mean to hold threat.
Improved Stormstrike (rank 1) gives a 50% chance of 50% regen while casting for 15 s, and a 50% chance to reset Stormstrike when you dodge or parry.
While your weapon has the matching imbue, you get nothing from a Windfury or Flametongue Totem, so don't plan on stacking the two.
Weapon imbues stack with sharpening stones and weightstones.

omitted.reason: The spec overview above covers this.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: Enhancement brings Stormstrike burst, faster Lightning Bolts from Maelstrom Weapon and Rage of the Farseer.
Purge strips enemy buffs and Tremor Totem counters fear, charm and sleep, but you have no stun or Hex (Warcraft Tavern).
Improved Ghost Wolf (instant at rank 2, usable indoors) is your mobility, and Improved Stormstrike can reset Stormstrike when you dodge or parry.
Against Mage: Blizzard calls Mages fragile in melee; instant Ghost Wolf (Improved Ghost Wolf at 2/2) helps you close the gap.

overview.lead: Restoration is the Shaman healer, built on Healing Wave, Chain Heal and totems, with Riptide at 31 points.

points.text: Forever adds Water Shield (11 points; mana when you are hit or your spells crit), moves Mana Tide Totem to 16 points, and adds Mindfulness so part of your regen continues while casting.
Riptide is now a heal over time on a 12-second cooldown with roughly 40% lower mana cost. It provides no upfront healing.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: The level-20 Water totem quest gives Healing Stream Totem; Mana Tide Totem ranks come at 25, 38, 48 and 58.
Healing Focus helps you finish heals while taking damage (23% chance at rank 1).
Dual Specialization at level 40 lets you keep Enhancement or Elemental for questing.
Improved Reincarnation shortens Reincarnation's cooldown and raises the health and mana you come back with.
Heal single targets with Healing Wave (Improved Healing Wave shortens it) and groups with Chain Heal.
Use Riptide for damage you expect to continue. Use a direct heal when the target needs health immediately.
Keep Water Shield up for mana, and drop Mana Spring and Healing Stream; Restorative Totems strengthens both.
Use Mana Tide Totem when your group runs low; rank 1 restores 88 mana every 3 s to group members within 30 yards for 12 s.
Nature's Swiftness makes your next Nature spell with a cast under 10 s instant; keep it for emergencies.
Set up a healing totem set for Call of the Elements, which drops four preset totems after a 3 s cast.
Buff totems now last 5 minutes, and you can right-click a totem in the tracker to dismiss it.
Ancestral Healing raises your target's armor (8% at rank 1) for 15 s after your heals crit.
Tremor Totem counters fear, charm and sleep (Warcraft Tavern).

omitted.reason: The spec overview above covers this.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: Mail and a shield help you take pressure. Nature's Swiftness helps with emergency healing, while Riptide heals gradually.
Purge and Tremor Totem are your answers to enemy buffs and fear; you have no hard crowd control (Warcraft Tavern).
Against Warlock: Keep Tremor Totem down against their Fear; Healing Focus helps you finish casts while their damage lands.
Against Priest: Forever Priests get Silence without a talent prerequisite. Apply Riptide before the silence if you can and reserve Nature's Swiftness for a direct heal after it ends.
